A new case from World of Code (WoC): 
A team has contacted the World of Code incubator with a new idea: to start a company that 
helps bloggers manage their social media presence. This company should have its own price 
list for its services and the ability to sell pre-made packages of several services. 
The company is planning to work with different kinds of social media. The services for each of

independent price lists within one program, for different types of media.
As a part of this project, it is also necessary to implement the ability for every price list to store 
its name, services, and prices.

The procedure for conducting A/B 
testing:
1.
All users are randomly divided into 2 groups -- control group A and control

2.
Group A is asked to use one version of the product, and group B is asked to 
use another. 
3.
After some time, an assessment is made about which of the two solutions was 
better (or which of the product versions turned out to have greater demand). 
4.
The product that provides the best test results is selected as the main one.
